about: Per-voice data coverage (PM 2026-11-03). GENERATED by tools/build_voice_coverage.py: required_fields (the `fields:` of every canon recogniser) and declared_unavailable (recognisers whose own `if:` says NOT_AVAILABLE, which carry no fields and were the prose-only blind spot). HAND-REVIEWED: conditional_blank, served_as, standing, capabilities. check.py coverage puts every required field in exactly one bucket: SERVED; SERVED AS (the canon's name for a column the packet carries under another name, source must itself be served); NOT SERVED (on the voice's menu, column absent or blank for every name = a data gap); AQE GAP (not on the menu and not an AQE export field); OFF MY MENU (AQE exports it, the menu omits it = a menu choice, never a gap); CONDITIONAL (blank by AQE's own documented rule). A NOT SERVED / AQE GAP field or a NOT_AVAILABLE recogniser blocks unless it is in `standing` / `capabilities` with a WRITTEN REASON (no 'snapshot' placeholders); standing items are printed on every run. A NEW gap always blocks.

conditional_blank.bracket.*: AQE glossary: a bracket field is null when the name has no valid structural bracket (house rule R1: a bracket is never a reject)
conditional_blank.structure_shift_ref: AQE glossary: null for a RANGE structure_shift (no broken level to measure against)

rvol.why: O'Neil R4 itself defines the input as day_vol: today's volume over its own 20-day average. AQE's day_vol is that, on his menu; 'rvol' is the recogniser's label.

stop.why: the structural stop AQE computes; Seow's own stop rules start from it (a bracket is never a reject: if invalid he names his own)

support_level.why: AQE's structural support level is the bracket stop; with no valid bracket he derives it from fib_swing_low / base_low_20d, both served

prior_support.why: minimum low of the last 20 bars: the base-of-consolidation reference; fib_swing_low is also served

breakout_bar_low.why: the last completed bar's low (prior_bar_low is also served); the seat reads the breakout bar off the bar_* columns

oneil.macro_brief: O'Neil R1's own fallback applies: a market gate not shown to him is marked DELEGATED. The macro seats are retired (R31); the weather (Valen stance, Crown line) reaches every seat in the VOTE packet, not the nomination packet, and is not a per-name column.
oneil.srm_weather: Same as macro_brief: the sector/market weather is a vote-packet block (Valen + Crown), not a per-name column; R1 delegates the gate when it is not shown at nomination.

seow.lane: Seow R10 states it: 'the vote packet states the lane'. It is a label the conductor writes into the VOTE packet, not a data column.
seow.setup_flag: An output of Seow's own recognisers (does a set-up bar exist), not an input; he derives it from the served bar_* columns.
seow.tick_size: A fixed fact, not data: the US equity minimum price increment is $0.01. The seat applies it.
seow.portfolio_value: Sizing input (R3 share count). Sizing is the PM's, by rule: AQE and the voices do not size; 1R is the single figure in aegis_fund.md (one_r_usd).
seow.risk_pct: Sizing input (R3 share count). Same reason as portfolio_value: the PM sizes; the voices do not.
seow.industry_group_pct_change_63d: AQE has no industry-group return series (only GICS sector ETFs, a broader group). Seow R8 says to substitute the group index 'where a group series is available'; where it is not, he uses the broad index, which is served as index_pct_change_63d. Not a gap by the recogniser's own text.
seow.current_stop: position-management input for an OPEN position (stop trail / time stop / exit trigger). The committee votes on candidates and holds; the PM manages and sizes the position at the broker. If the PM wants Seow to apply this to held names, add the held-row columns to his menu (held_book.held_sl, held_book.trade_date, held_book.held_tp1 exist; days_held and high_since_entry would be new AQE fields).
